levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Two or more categories are left completely blank rather than answered with a storage-type label or an honest 'I don't know.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All six categories have either a storage-type label or an honest 'I don't know.'

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All six categories are answered, and the least-sure category includes a specific, realistic next step rather than a vague one.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: An actual document number, account number, or other identifier appears anywhere in the response.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Only category and storage-type labels appear; no identifiers are present.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner's own language shows they understand why identifiers are excluded, not just that the rule exists.

lookFors: No document number, account number, password, or government identifier appears anywhere in the response.
'I don't know' appears at least once if genuinely applicable, rather than every category being filled in implausibly.
The least-sure-category step is specific enough that the learner could actually try it this week.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
